title: Vienna · Wachau and Mariazell Roads
slogan: A 294 km loop out of Krems Wachau
story: Danube beauty with a mountain finish. A 294 km loop that starts and ends near Krems an der Donau, about 5 h 39 of riding. It goes by way of Melk Abbey and Mariazell mountain town. Semmering Pass is the high point. It tops out at about 1,050 m. It is a high-mountain day.
